notes: dims 384 matches common small embedding models (e.g. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 / bge-small). If you embed with a 768-dim model, change dims to 768 before creating the index — changing it after indexing requires reindexing.
start_time/end_time are keywords, not dates, because many seed talks have no verified time (null in the JSON). Conflict detection must only use talks where both are present; see seed-and-search.py.
Hybrid search = multi_match on title^3 + abstract + tags, combined with a kNN query on `embedding`. In ES 8.x use a single search with both `query` and `knn`.
For the demo, seed the index from kubecon-talks-seed.json with seed-and-search.py, then run the Tuesday 11:25 clash as the conflict demo.
